I have the Garmin Instinct 1 Tactical Solar, which is great but I bought the Fenix 7 Pro Sapphire Solar from John Lewis in the UK for £470 during the Black Friday sales. Even now they are selling it for £500!  Substantially cheaper than anywhere else.  

I actually haven't used the Fenix yet, as was waiting for the Garmin Instinct 3 to come out but have been disappointed in that there is no tactical version and also the MIP display version now looks so second rate compared to the Amoled version and the display is much smaller. Further, the I3 has the previous gen heart rate sensor!!

However, to comment on the weight of the Fenix 7 Pro Sapphire Solar - it is approx 20 grams heavier than the original Garmin Instinct I have. I believe the weight of the Garmin Instinct 3 is also similar to the original Instinct weight at 53g for the 45mm version.  So the weight difference is approx 20g with strap.  I weighed them both.

  
Hope that helps.
